scenes.focusTo: Headline settles; attribution line reads underneath.
scenes.purpose: Open on the goal-to-workflow idea, attributed as MiniMax's own description of agents teaming up.
Show the real MiniMax Code interface and land on the message input where a goal is entered.
Lay out the three first-party product claims as filled cards under a clear MiniMax attribution, with no measured results.
Close on the supplied CTA and URL label with no added promise.

card-creation.text: Images, video, audio, scripts and voiceovers

hook-headline.text: One goal. A team of agents.

hook-sub.text: MiniMax describes agents teaming up to tackle tasks.

treatment.continuity: White background, brand blue accent and Geist Sans carry from title through endcard. The goal typed in the real interface input leads into the cards describing what MiniMax says happens next, then the CTA. Soft mallet bed at 92 bpm with no victory sting. Every claim is framed as MiniMax's description; no measured outcomes, speed, cost or ranking appear.
